description: Read and manage Hashnode publications, posts, and drafts through the Hashnode GraphQL API.

auth.label: Personal Access Token
auth.description: Hashnode Personal Access Token sent as a Bearer credential. Create or manage tokens in Hashnode Account Settings > Developer: https://hashnode.com/settings/developer

actions.name: create_draft
actions.description: Create a draft in a Hashnode publication with an active Pro plan.

disableComments.description: Whether comments should be disabled on the resulting post.

originalArticleURL.description: The canonical URL when the resulting post was originally published elsewhere.

publishedAt.description: The timestamp to use when backdating the resulting post.

actions.name: list_my_publications
actions.description: List publications available to the authenticated Hashnode user.

first.description: The number of publications to return, from 1 through 100.

anyOf.description: The publication URL when configured.

anyOf.description: The post subtitle when configured.

brief.description: The post summary generated by Hashnode.

publishedAt.description: The publication timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

anyOf.description: The last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: The last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

anyOf.description: The cursor to pass as after for the next page.

endCursor.description: The cursor to pass as after for the next page.
